resources.string: Watch with friends who use Syncplay. Each person opens their own video; this mode shares playback controls.
Unencrypted connection: use only on a trusted local network. Other devices on the network may read the session.

The server can read your nickname, room, video title, duration, playback state and chat. Video files, source addresses and access credentials are not shared. This mode does not use the end-to-end encryption of Nyanime rooms.
Allow sharing these details with this server
TLS active · the server can still read session details
Enter a valid host:port, nickname and ordinary room name. Operator rooms are not supported.
Connection interrupted. Check the server address and Internet connection, then reconnect.
A verified TLS connection could not be established. Check the server certificate and TLS support.
The server sent an invalid or unsupported response. The local video remains available.
The server refused the connection. Check its password, room requirements and client compatibility.
Open a video in Nyanime to join playback

Open the same episode and edition as the others, then confirm it here. Nyanime will not open a video based on a remote filename. Shared playlists, operator rooms, live TV, manga and Cast are not supported in this mode.
Aligning your video with the room…
Syncplay uses normal playback speed. Small speed corrections remain automatic.
